entries.text: If Cassandra Spender's life is in danger, why not Scully's?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I believe Cassandra Spender represents the final stages of these experiments-- that she may very well be the first successful alien/human hybrid.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What I don't understand is if she was a success, why is her life threatened?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Because... The men who created her would rather kill her... Than let her expose the enterprise.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: She's under 24-hour guard.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Assigned by agent Spender?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You've never seen one before, have you? It's shocking at first-- the acceptance of the idea. It's something you thought only children... And fools believed in. It undermines your beliefs... In yourself, in the world. But then you come to understand.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: Understand what?
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Well, the responsibility that this knowledge demands by the men who have it. The great sacrifice... By great men like... Your father.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: What sacrifice?
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: The sacrifice of your mother.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: What do you know about that?
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Just that she's been the subject of an experiment for 25 years.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: My father's involved in that? Is he?
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Your father directs the experiments.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: So I'm protecting her now so the experiments can continue?
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: That's why he put you on the X-Files. That's why your father sent you here tonight. You're protecting the project, Jeffrey, making the sacrifices... So that you can be a great man too.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: I'll be my own great man.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: I've trusted no one. Treachery is the inevitable result of all affairs. Every man believes he has his own good reason. I have little doubt of my son's disloyalty to me. Certainly he led Mulder and Scully to us. His mother must know by now her central role in the grand plan, that she's as much alien as human. Do you wonder why I've chosen you? You've never betrayed me. Now I need someone to trust.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I'll help you. It's not too late.
entries.speaker: Diana Fowley

entries.text: [ door opens ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ door closes ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Cassandra? Ms. Spender?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Where's my mother?
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: You tell me, agent Spender.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Where's the guard? I-I had a guard posted here.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: I got here, and she was gone.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: He took her.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Who? Agent Spender?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: [ frantic knocking ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ panting ] Cassandra.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I can't believe I found you.
entries.speaker: Cassandra Spender

entries.text: How did you find us? Cassandra?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: How did you get here? How'd you get out of your room?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Where'd you get your clothes?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Agent Scully, agent Mulder, you cannot let them find me.
entries.speaker: Cassandra Spender

entries.text: [ knocking continues ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Stop it. Let go! You cannot let them have me. You have got to kill me now! If you don't kill me, it all starts! There won't be any stopping it.
entries.speaker: Cassandra Spender

entries.text: [ frantic knocking ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I am the one! You have to shoot me, please!
entries.speaker: Cassandra Spender

entries.text: [ knocking continues ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder, what are you doing?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Stand away, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder!
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ knocking continues ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder, we have to protect her.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ harsh pounding on door ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder. Mulder! [ pounding continues ]
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
